name: EasyError- Easy Error Log for WordPress
author: Sabbir Sam

sections.description:
Introducing EasyError – Your Ultimate Debugging Companion for WordPress

With a modern and intuitive UI, EasyError simplifies error tracking and log management. Easily identify issues, manage debug logs, and keep your site running smoothly without diving into complex configurations.

Key Features

🔗 Open Errors locally Directly in Your Favorite Code Editor

Jump to the source of an error instantly with one click. Supported editors:

  • VS Code
  • Sublime Text
  • PHPStorm
  • Atom

🖥️ Frontend Widgets for Real-Time Debugging

Easily view issues directly on the frontend with interactive floating widgets.

🛠️ Comprehensive System Information

Get detailed insights into your WordPress and server environment:
– System Information
– WordPress Environment Information
– Server Information
– Theme & Plugins Information
– Active Theme Information
– Active Plugins Information
– User Basic Information

📂 Seamless Log Management

  • View all errors in a user-friendly dashboard.
  • Clean, refresh, and download error logs effortlessly.
  • Toggle debug mode without modifying core files.

Upgrade your debugging experience with EasyError – Easy Error Log for WordPress and gain full control over your site’s error logs today! 🚀

🔥 More Awesome Plugins

If you enjoy FormDeck, you ought to take a look at our other great projects:

🤖 Activity Guard – Real-Time System & User Activity Logs, Forum Tracker and Security Plugin (Free & Pro)
Activity Guard is the Ultimate WordPress activity log plugin for tracking user actions, monitoring WooCommerce events, and securing your site in real-time. With instant notifications via Slack and email, it empowers admins to respond quickly to critical events and ensure site security.

🛒 WC Bulk Order Generator (Free)
WC Bulk Generator helps developers and store owners create realistic WooCommerce test data quickly. Generate thousands of WooCommerce products and orders with just a few clicks.

📑 FormDeck: Simple Form Builder with WhatsApp Floating Forms (Free)
FormDeck form builder is 100% Free with awesome premium features for effortless form building. FormDeck empowers WordPress users to create engaging forms that convert visitors into leads. With our intuitive drag and drop builder, CF7 and WhatsApp integration, you can start meaningful conversations with potential customers instantly.

How to Use

After activating the plugin navigate to your Admin Dashboard > WP Error Log > Activate the plugin.
Active the debug log from Dashboard and enjoy receiving instant error while generate in website
sections.installation:
1. Upload files to the /wp-content/plugins/wp-error-log directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress
sections.faq:
Do I need to manually define WP_DEBUG PHP constant

No, manual definition of the WP_DEBUG PHP constant is not necessary. Instead, you can directly add or modify it from the plugin dashboard page
